name: M6.Coordinates.encode_sum
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (h : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Coordinates.encode N h = ∑ i : ZMod N, AdjoinRoot.of (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) (h i) * M6.Coordinates.rootPow N i
queries: AdjoinRoot quotient mk power basis ZMod finite sum
guidance: Map polynomial finite sum through AdjoinRoot.mk, map_C/map_X; convert FinN sum to ZModN via explicit equivalence preserving val. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
